About me

I’m Pious, a graphic designer, videographer and video editor based in Cape Coast, Ghana.

I design social media graphics, flyers, posters and branded visuals, and I edit photos and short videos for brands, events and organisations. I work in Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom and Premiere Pro.

I start by understanding what a client wants to achieve. Then I turn it into clear, engaging content that follows their brand guidelines and speaks to their audience. I manage several projects at once and keep to deadlines without lowering quality.
